text:
Maria (AE): FYI - New enterprise RFP from 'Northern Medical' landed. They flagged identity + governance items as blockers: dual IdP (Okta & Azure AD), SCIM provisioning with <5s delta for some roles (they call it near-realtime), delegated RBAC, DNS TXT domain proofing, and CMK support for stored secrets. Want a 2-week POC and security questionnaire answers. Who can run tech presales?

Aj Shah: I can lead. Need their SAML metadata for both Okta and Azure AD, and a SCIM sandbox that mirrors ~200 users with nested groups. Also ask them whether they want delta events for groups or only user lifecycle.

Nisha K: Heads-up from Sec: they included HIPAA in scope and want SOC2 artifact excerpts + encryption at rest with CMK. We'll need the full questionnaire PDF to mark exceptions. They also request audit trails for SCIM writes (who/when).

Leo - Eng: On SCIM throughput: our hosted product batches deltas at 60s default. Dedicated deployment can achieve sub-10s commit latency with tuned workers and higher API concurrency. For POC we can spin a dedicated tenant or ephemeral private control plane. Need to know expected churn (adds/updates per minute).

SalesOps: Pricing signal: ephemeral private POC (Dedicated-style infra) has a setup fee and a short reserved minimum for the month; hosted POC is free under credits but may not meet CMK / VPC requirements. I'll draft two scenarios.

Maria (AE): They also asked we demonstrate delegated RBAC where a customer admin can create scoped service accounts limited to a single tenant and audit scope. Is that standard?

Leo - Eng: Yes we support role inheritance and scoped admin tokens. Example RBAC mapping we use in POCs: 

```
# mapping example
scim_group: "engineering-admins"
redwood_role: "org_admin"
scopes: ["projects:read","projects:write","billing:read"]
```

We can provide a script to apply mappings via API during the demo.

Aj Shah: For domain proofing they prefer DNS TXT. We support DNS TXT and email verification; for large orgs DNS TXT is preferred. Also confirm whether they require multi-tenant domain claims (subdomain verification) or a root org domain.

Nisha K: SAML note: confirm whether they require encrypted assertions (AES-256) in addition to signed assertions. Azure AD handles encryption slightly differently than Okta; we'll need to validate cert exchange.

Maria (AE): Action list: Aj - request SAML metadata for both IdPs, SCIM sandbox, sample user CSV (200 users) + churn profile by EOD tomorrow. Leo - can you open infra ticket for ephemeral private POC (include CMK + VPC peering)? SalesOps - two pricing scenarios by Friday. Nisha - ready to intake questionnaire once attached; will flag legal escalations.

SecurityBot: Please review the provisioning security checklist: https://redwood.com/security/provisioning-checklist :lock:

Aj Shah: On it. Reached out to Northern Medical for the artifacts. Will post updates. :white_check_mark:
